additions.name: SONDA Kudos, Quilicura

status.summary: SONDA demonstrated operations at its Kudos data center during a November 3 visit.

locator.precision: Regulator reference for the whole Quilicura campus; the individual Kudos building position is unspecified.
locator.identity_review: Chile’s regulator identifies the SONDA campus and its expansion. SONDA registers Kudos and a separate Quilicura facility entry at Víctor Uribe Sur 2211. Cirion SAN2 has its own regulatory filing for Víctor Uribe Sur 2290. This point represents the SONDA campus, including Kudos.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The regulator gives no numerical horizontal accuracy for its facility point.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked operator and project aliases, address, and named properties across 1,668 sites, 1,816 projects and all 231 entries in each imported-record, mapping and decision layer. The nearest prior geometry is Cirion SAN2 Quilicura, 184 m away.
additions.successor_review: SONDA’s integrated report distinguishes Kudos from DCQ1 at Quilicura. SONDA subsequently demonstrated operations at Kudos during the November visit.

additions.name: Araico Iguazú AI City, initial campus development

status.summary: On November 12 the industry ministry documented site preparation for Araico’s AI data center on former agricultural land in Yguazú.

locator.precision: Representative interior point of the three-lot project property, derived from two printed reference coordinates.
locator.identity_review: The filing identifies the applicant, the Yguazú parcels and their planned AI data center. Crusoe identifies the same applicant as Araico’s CEO. The ministry names Araico and Iguazú AI City on the former agricultural property. The municipal register separately lists HIVE, PARDAT and the Araico development.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The applicant does not report positional accuracy for the project reference points or individual facility locations within the 87.7256-hectare property.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked operator and project aliases, address, and named properties across 1,668 sites, 1,816 projects and all 231 entries in each imported-record, mapping and decision layer. The nearest prior geometry is HIVE Yguazú Paraguay Campus, 1,806 m away.
additions.successor_review: A November 12 ministry account documents site preparation and the municipal project register lists construction. The developer’s initial operation date was a forecast. No operating hall is inferred.

additions.name: Google Ozans Data Centre — proposed campus

status.summary: On November 13, Google and RTE held a public consultation meeting on the proposed Google data centre campus in the Ozans development zone at Étrechet.

locator.method: Area centroid of Étrechet parcel A 46 in Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154), transformed back to WGS84. The sponsors’ project illustration and IGN orthophoto establish campus identity.
locator.precision: Centroid of one cadastral parcel wholly within the roughly 200-hectare proposed campus. This point locates the campus at parcel scale.
locator.identity_review: The sponsors illustrate the proposed campus inside the wider ZAC. Independent registration to IGN orthophotography places all of A 46 inside that campus, with the selected centroid about 509 m inside the illustrated boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The project illustration provides no surveyed campus boundary or absolute accuracy for the campus locator.

additions.distinctness_review: The Étrechet development zone is separate from Google’s existing campus records. Name and municipality were checked against prior project, site and source identities. The nearest baseline site is Castle IT Larçay, 97.4 km away.
additions.successor_review: The project sponsor records the November 13 consultation. The following November notices concern consultation events. The first building was proposed for around 2030.

additions.name: YEXIO Heiligenhaus — existing operations

status.summary: HOCHTIEF confirmed that the Heiligenhaus data centre received the Blue Angel for its energy- and resource-efficient operation at the federal environment ministry’s September 22 conference.

locator.method: Published WGS84 point for the matching civic address from the official NRW building reference register.
locator.precision: Official address point for the YEXIO property at Bertha-Benz-Allee 5 in Innovationspark Heiligenhaus.
locator.identity_review: The developer’s groundbreaking invitation gives Bertha-Benz-Allee 5. The industrial park independently identifies the same corner at Fahrenheitstraße.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The source gives no numerical horizontal accuracy for the address reference.

additions.distinctness_review: The nearest baseline property is AtlasEdge DUS001 Düsseldorf Data Centre (Zum Jägerhof 10, Hilden), 14.3 km away. Searches of the baseline project, site and source identities found no matching facility, company or city alias.
additions.successor_review: The centre opened in September 2025. In October 2026 HOCHTIEF confirmed the award for its operation at the September 22 conference. The November 6 Bad Lippspringe disclosure identifies the earlier Heiligenhaus completion without dating another observation of operation.

additions.name: YEXIO Bad Lippspringe — existing operations

status.summary: At the November 6 inauguration, HOCHTIEF confirmed that the second YEXIO data centre was operating in Bad Lippspringe.

locator.method: Area centroid of the named OpenStreetMap data-centre building in ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N, transformed back to WGS84.
locator.precision: Representative point inside the mapped YEXIO data-centre building at Raiffeisenstraße 1i.
locator.identity_review: OpenStreetMap names the building YEXIO, identifies its data-centre use and gives its municipal address. The opening release and the city identify the YEXIO facility in Bad Lippspringe. NRW independently confirms the same civic address.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapped footprint provides no surveyed horizontal accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: The nearest baseline property is Stadtwerke Bielefeld Rechenzentrum 3, Schweriner Straße, 30.1 km away. Searches of the baseline project, site and source identities found no matching facility, company or city alias.
additions.successor_review: The city subsequently confirmed the operation announcement on November 11. Statements about capacity sold across the YEXIO network were excluded from the individual facility.

additions.name: NorthC Berlin 2 — existing operations

status.summary: NorthC identified its existing Berlin 2 data centre in Neukölln in its October 15 report, distinguishing it from Berlin 1 scheduled for 2027.

locator.method: Direct WGS84 coordinates of the matching OpenStreetMap civic address node.
locator.precision: Address point for Gradestraße 60 at the operator’s published colocation property.
locator.identity_review: The operator’s individual Berlin 2 colocation page gives Gradestraße 60. OpenStreetMap node 2092034595 version 2 carries the same street and house number.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OpenStreetMap gives no surveyed accuracy value for this feature.

additions.distinctness_review: The nearest baseline property is NTT Berlin 2, 4.00 km away. The existing NorthC records and former operator and street aliases were checked for physical overlap.
additions.successor_review: The current operator lists this specific property as an existing colocation facility. Scheduled upgrades and service from other NorthC properties were excluded from its status.
